_comment: A7 item 20(a) / F-B04-4: a second Oscillator ('deadosc') is wired to nothing - a normal editing pattern (dragged in to audition, then abandoned half-wired). Codegen performs no dead-node elimination, so it is still fully emitted and executed every sample forever, contributing nothing. This fixture pins that warn_unreachable_nodes prints a non-fatal stderr warning naming the orphaned node, while the emitted .odin (the golden) is completely unchanged - dead-code elimination itself is out of scope for this fix.
